title: 第1198章 不要你还捡真没品第1197章 有没有兴趣研究一下全新的万象境啊
slug: 你是来修仙还是来观光的
lines: 真不吉利。”
敖青骂骂咧咧的往一旁吐了口唾沫道。
一大坨“龙涎”
啪的一下浇在了一旁的树上，黏黏糊糊的，怪恶心的。
“啧，怎么随地乱吐痰啊，真是没素质。”
郑常嫌弃道。
“什么吐痰，那是龙涎，这棵树就捡着了吧，有龙涎浇灌，必定要茁壮成长了。
它要有灵，得跟我说谢谢。”
敖青道。
倒也说的没错，元婴龙族的唾沫，用来炼药什么的不够，但确实是蕴含点灵气，浇在花花草草上，确实能助力生长。
“你话也许说得有点道理，但你这态度我不喜欢。
是不是要突破你飘了？这么得瑟？”
郑常道。
敖青心想，都是让脑子里那家伙影响了。
那家伙肯定有躁狂症，整天听他哔哔，自己也有点躁狂了。
“咳咳……还不是常哥你，说什么带我看看别人渡雷劫，看这劫雷灾过后有没有异常。
结果带我看了三场，劈死了三个渡劫的。
我都怀疑你是不是故意找这种会失败的家伙来膈应我了。”
看榜忌讳落榜人。
要渡劫了，偏偏来看失败案例，这不是打击信心吗？
“确实不太吉利啊。
这不就看出端倪来了么？说不定就是雷灾后，渡劫成功率变低了。
早发现还不好吗？”
“扯蛋呢，我又不是感受不到劫云的气息，根本没明显加强好吧。
就是三个倒霉蛋，你精挑细选的倒霉蛋。
看了他们，我感觉我也要变倒霉了。”
“说不定是看了他们倒霉，你就转运了呢？他们都为你负重前行了，你不得岁月静好啊？”
“你别扯淡了。”
敖青没好气道，“也别再找别人的渡劫看了，他们成不成，我不也一样要突破吗？”
“我这是怕你死了，你个不知好歹的家伙。”
郑常笑道，“算了，有三次例子，应该能确定了，劫雷灾应该没影响到普通渡劫，你准备准备也可以渡劫了。”
content_en:
“Bah!
How unlucky. "
Ao Qing cursed and spat aside.
A big lump of "ambergris saliva"
I splashed it on the tree nearby. It was sticky and disgusting.
"Tsk, why are you spitting everywhere? You are really unqualified."
Zheng Chang said disgustedly.
"What spit, that's ambergris, just pick it up on this tree. If it's watered by ambergris, it will surely grow strong.
It has to have spirit and say thank you to me. "
Ao Qing said.
It's true that the saliva of the Nascent Soul Dragon Clan is not enough for refining medicine, but it does contain some spiritual energy. When poured on flowers and plants, it can indeed help their growth.
"You may have some truth in what you say, but I don't like your attitude.
Are you about to break through? So cool? "
Zheng Chang said.
Ao Qing thought to himself that it was all influenced by the guy in his mind.
That guy must be manic. Listening to him beeping all day makes me a little manic myself.
"Ahem...Brother Chang, why don't you show me how others have gone through the thunder tribulation and see if there are any abnormalities after the thunder tribulation.
As a result, he took me to watch three games and killed three people who were trying to escape the tribulation.
I even wonder if you deliberately found this kind of failure guy to irritate me. "
It is taboo to look at people who have failed in the rankings.
We are about to overcome the tribulation, but we only look at failure cases. Doesn’t this undermine confidence?
“It’s really unlucky.
Doesn’t this give us a clue? Maybe after the thunder disaster, the success rate of overcoming the disaster has become lower.
Wouldn't it be better to catch it early? "
"That's nonsense, it's not like I can't feel Jie Yun's aura, it's not significantly strengthened at all.
Just three unlucky guys, the unlucky guys you carefully selected.
Looking at them, I felt like I was going to be unlucky too. "
"Perhaps it's because you saw them being unlucky that things changed for you? They all carried the burden for you, so you can't wait for the rest of the year, okay?"
"Stop talking nonsense."
Ao Qing said angrily, "Don't look for other people to overcome the tribulation. Whether they succeed or not, don't I also have to break through?"
"I'm afraid you'll die, you ungrateful guy."
Zheng Chang smiled and said, "Forget it, with three examples, we should be able to confirm that the thunder disaster should not affect the ordinary tribulation. You can also overcome the tribulation if you are prepared."
